booking.privateLink: اللينك ده خاص بيك ومنه هتدخل الجلسة. احفظه ومتبعتهوش لحد.
This link is private to you and is how you'll join the session. Keep it safe and don't share it.
booking.whatsappHint: هنبعتلك عليه تأكيد الحجز وأي تحديث.
We'll send your confirmation and any updates here.
booking.acceptTopUp: فاهم إن لو الجروب مكملش هتكلموني قبل الجلسة وأختار: أدفع الفرق، أو أنقل لميعاد تاني، أو أسترد فلوسي.
I understand that if the group doesn't fill, you'll contact me before the session and I choose: pay the difference, move to another time, or get a refund.
booking.acceptTerms: I agree to the booking and cancellation terms.
booking.payTitle: Pay and upload the transfer screenshot
booking.proofRejected: الإيصال السابق اترفض: {reason}. ارفع صورة تانية.
Your previous receipt was rejected: {reason}. Please upload another one.
booking.transferHint: حوّل {amount} واكتب رقم الحجز {ref} في الملاحظات لو ينفع.
Transfer {amount} and, if you can, write the booking reference {ref} in the transfer note.
booking.senderRef: رقم العملية أو الرقم اللي حوّلت منه
Transaction number or the number you paid from
booking.orWhatsapp: Or send the receipt on WhatsApp
booking.reviewTitle: We've received your receipt and are checking it
booking.reviewBody: مكانك محجوز. أول ما نأكد الدفع الصفحة دي هتتحدث، وهنبعتلك على واتساب.
Your seat is held. As soon as we confirm the payment this page will update and we'll message you on WhatsApp.
booking.openSameLink: افتح نفس اللينك ده في الميعاد.
Open this same link at the session time.
booking.topUpBody: الجروب وصل {n} طلاب بس (أقل من {min}). علشان الجلسة تتم بنفس الميعاد، المطلوب فرق {amount}.
The group reached only {n} students (fewer than {min}). To keep the session at the same time, the difference is {amount}.
booking.topUpReview: استلمنا إيصال الفرق وبنراجعه. أول ما يتأكد حجزك هيرجع مؤكد.
We've received the difference receipt and are checking it. Your booking will be confirmed again once approved.
booking.choicePayHint: and attend at the same time
booking.choiceMoveHint: we'll arrange it with you on WhatsApp
booking.refundPendingBody: هنرجّعلك فلوسك على نفس الرقم اللي حوّلت منه، وهنبلغك على واتساب أول ما تتحوّل.
We'll send the money back to the number you paid from and let you know on WhatsApp once it's done.
booking.anyHelp: لو محتاج أي حاجة كلّمنا على واتساب.
If you need anything, message us on WhatsApp.
booking.transferTitle: We'll move you to another time
booking.transferBody: هنكلمك على واتساب نتفق على الميعاد الجديد، وحجزك الجديد هيوصلك على لينك جديد.
We'll agree the new time with you on WhatsApp, and your new booking will come with a new link.
booking.cancelledBody: تقدر تحجز جلسة تانية في أي وقت.
You can book another session any time.
booking.expiredBody: المقعد اتفك علشان البيانات أو الإيصال موصلوش في الوقت. تقدر تحجز تاني لو لسه فيه أماكن.
The seat was released because the details or receipt didn't arrive in time. You can book again if seats are left.
booking.anyQuestion: لو عندك أي سؤال كلّمنا على واتساب.
If you have any questions, message us on WhatsApp.
booking.cancelFull: لو لغيت دلوقتي هترجعلك فلوسك كاملة (الإلغاء المجاني لحد {until}).
Cancel now for a full refund (free cancellation until {until}).
booking.cancelNoRefund: فاضل وقت قليل على الجلسة، فالإلغاء دلوقتي مش بيرجّع الفلوس.
The session is close, so cancelling now is not refunded.
booking.acceptNoRefund: I agree to cancel without a refund
booking.cancelUnpaid: لسه مدفعتش، فالإلغاء هيفك المقعد بس.
You haven't paid yet, so cancelling just releases the seat.
booking.help: Need help? Message us on WhatsApp
booking.needFile: اختار طريقة الدفع وارفع صورة التحويل.
Choose a payment method and upload the transfer screenshot.
booking.confirmCancel: Are you sure you want to cancel this booking?
